text:
emily: hey team — day one! hitting a 403 on https://console.staging.redwood.ai/ after SSO+MFA. need to flip demo_flag in staging for a customer demo in ~2h. who owns staging/admin access or a quick path for temporary elevation?

jessica: welcome emily :tada: You need to be in `staging-admins` or `ff-operators`. Quick option: JIT access via https://jit.redwood.ai select `staging-console-admin` and request up to 4h. If urgent, ping infra-ops.

matt: i can hook you up for the demo. @emily what's your SSO id? i'll grant a short window and confirm console/FF panel access.
emily: thanks! my SSO is `emily.redwood`. also — our demo script toggles the flag via curl. is there a recommended service account or CLI flow?

ana: heads up, i'm ana (but our slack auto-correct shows nana sometimes lol). For programmatic toggles, use `ff-ci-bot` svc account (scoped). Interactive route: `redwood auth login --service ff-ci-bot --env staging` then `redwood ff toggle --flag demo_flag --on --env staging`. All changes are audited. If no svc-account perms, get JIT and one of us can toggle.

infra-bot: JIT request created: #JIT-8882 by emily.redwood for `staging-console-admin` duration 3h. Status: pending approval.
matt: approved. added `emily.redwood` to `staging-admins` for 3h (expires in ~180m). try loading the console and open Feature Flags.
emily: confirmed — console loads and i can see `demo_flag`. thanks! quick Q: where's canonical owners list for flags? want to add rollout note for the demo.
jessica: flags catalog: https://flags.redwood.ai/catalog — owners column shows maintainers. If empty, add a reviewer in Notes or ping the product owner on the flag page. Reminder: prod toggles need two approvers.
emily: added rollout note and linked demo plan. super helpful, thanks all :rocket:
